team.title: Team guide and limits
team.intro: Teams share schedules, matches, tasks, and files. Available features depend on what the team administrator enables.
team.featuresDescription: Optional team features and their current status. Members can use features enabled by an administrator.
team.qa1Question: Can members manage schedules or posts?
team.qa1Answer: Administrators manage them by default. A team administrator can allow members to manage schedules, files, and posts separately in the default member permissions.
team.qa2Answer: A team administrator chooses features in Feature Settings. Members can see the available features and their status here.
team.qa3Question: How is a team different from an organization?
team.qa3Answer: A team is for day-to-day activities and matches. An organization has a separate feature catalog and storage allowance for wider operations.

organization.title: Organization guide and limits
organization.intro: Organizations share information across teams and support organization-wide operations. Available features depend on what the organization administrator enables.
organization.featuresDescription: Optional organization features and their current status. The feature catalog differs from a team's.
organization.qa1Answer: An organization administrator chooses features in Feature Settings. Members can see the available features and their status here.
organization.qa2Answer: No. Organizations and teams have separate storage allowances. Check Storage Usage to see each allowance.
organization.qa3Question: How are member management permissions decided?
organization.qa3Answer: Administrators manage things by default. An organization administrator can change default member permissions. Assigned permission groups take precedence.

setup.title: Set initial member permissions
setup.intro: Only administrators can manage these activities by default. Allow members only the actions they need. You can save with every switch off.
setup.MANAGE_SCHEDULES: Members can create and edit schedules.
setup.MANAGE_POSTS: Members can create posts and edit their own posts.
